name: Dr. Srivani Palukuri, PhD
bio:
Dr. Srivani Palukuri, PhD is a seasoned clinical researcher with over a decade of experience in national and multinational pharmaceutical organizations. She has led and managed clinical trials addressing medicines for unmet needs, with a focus on making affordable solutions accessible across diverse indications. In her corporate career, she worked together with cross-functional teams across India, Europe, and the US, and contributed to the scientific community through impactful publications and communications.

Today, she channels this depth of expertise into evidence-based, compassionate services for neurodivergent children and their families through the Vathsalya Child Neuronurture Centre—bridging clinical excellence with compassionate care.

Her focus on neurodiversity grew from personal experience: after her son was diagnosed with mild autism spectrum disorder with associated delays in speech and social communication, she became determined to create an inclusive environment where children with special needs can learn and flourish according to their individual strengths. Her vision is to nurture children so they develop the physical, social, emotional, and practical skills needed to become self-reliant and confident adults.

name: Keturah David
bio:
Keturah David, M.Phil (Rehabilitation Psychology), is a Child Psychologist with over 12 years of experience assessing and treating developmental, behavioral, and neurodevelopmental disorders in children and adolescents. She specializes in assessment, diagnosis, intervention planning, behavior modification, and developmental support for children and adolescents aged 0–18.

Drawing on expertise in rehabilitation psychology, multidisciplinary care, research, and parent-guided intervention, she is dedicated to empowering children and families through evidence-based, compassionate, and individualized psychological support. Keturah pairs rigorous, evidence-based practice with a warm, child-centered approach that nurtures developmental growth, emotional well-being, and functional independence, and she remains committed to advancing research and innovation in child mental health and developmental care.

name: Dr. Sakshi Rolstan
bio:
Sakshi Rolstan is a dedicated and compassionate Occupational Therapist with over 10 years of clinical experience in pediatric rehabilitation, neurodevelopmental intervention, and disability support services. She specializes in assessing and managing children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), ADHD, Cerebral Palsy, developmental delays, and other neurodevelopmental conditions, conducting comprehensive functional assessments and designing individualized, evidence-based intervention plans to improve functional independence and participation in daily life.

Sakshi is proficient in sensory processing assessment, ADL training, therapeutic play, and behavioral support strategies, and brings strong expertise in interdisciplinary collaboration across educational, clinical, and community-based rehabilitation settings. She is passionate about early intervention, child development, and family-centered care, and is committed to empowering children to reach their fullest potential through holistic, goal-oriented therapy.

name: Dr. Mrudula Srinath
bio: Dr. Mrudula Srikanth is a Certified Physiotherapist with over 14 years of clinical experience in musculoskeletal rehabilitation, post-operative recovery, sports injury management, paediatric physiotherapy including early childhood development. She specialises in creating personalised, evidence-based therapy programmes aimed at improving mobility, recovery, motor skills, functional independence, and overall physical wellbeing across all age groups. With a compassionate and patient-centred approach, Dr. Mrudula is dedicated to delivering effective rehabilitation outcomes through strong clinical expertise, excellent communication, and holistic care. Her passion for health and wellness enables her to support patients in achieving improved quality of life and long-term physical health.

name: Tania Joe
bio:
Tania Joe holds a Master’s degree in Psychology and Wellbeing from Dublin and brings valuable experience across multidisciplinary healthcare, psychological services, and child development settings. Her professional background includes working in collaborative healthcare environments with a focus on psychological support, special education, developmental assessment, clinical documentation, and multidisciplinary care coordination.

She has experience supporting children and families through family-centred approaches, with particular interests in child psychology, developmental disorders, behavioural support, and early intervention.

name: Sadhana Lakkaraju
qualification: Postgraduate Diploma in Dance Movement Psychotherapy, University of Derby, UK; Background in Psychology
bio:
Sadhana Lakkaraju is a Bharatanatyam dancer and Dance Movement Psychotherapy practitioner, holding a Postgraduate Diploma in Dance Movement Psychotherapy from the University of Derby, UK, and a background in Psychology. Her experience spans educational, therapeutic, and developmental settings, where she has worked closely with children with special needs and their families.

During her undergraduate studies in Psychology, she worked with Samarthanam as a Junior Special Educator and full-time Dance Teacher, supporting children with intellectual and physical disabilities through inclusive education, creative movement, and skill development. This experience deepened her understanding of diverse developmental needs and the importance of creating supportive, accessible environments for every child.

Through her training and practice in Dance Movement Psychotherapy, she supports children's emotional, social, and developmental growth using movement-based and creative interventions that encourage self-expression, confidence, and meaningful engagement—with particular interest in child development, neurodiversity, special education, emotional well-being, and creative arts therapies. Sadhana is passionate about creating safe, inclusive, strengths-based spaces where children can thrive, connect, and express themselves authentically.

name: Fatima Khan
qualification: RCI-Certified Special Educator, Master's in Psychology, B.Ed. in Special Education
bio:
Fatima Khan is an RCI-certified Special Educator with a Master's degree in Psychology and a B.Ed. in Special Education. She is dedicated to supporting children with diverse learning and developmental needs through individualized educational and therapeutic interventions.

Her areas of expertise include IEP development, adaptive skill training, inclusive education, sign language communication, and progress monitoring. Fatima's work centers on helping children build independence, confidence, and meaningful participation in everyday life—guided by a child-centered, evidence-based approach that fosters holistic growth across academic, social, emotional, and functional domains.
